bundle.shortDescription: All-in-one workspace: notes, tasks, calendar, habits, AI copilot, game layer.
bundle.longDescription: Pebble is a local-first all-in-one workspace: block notes, wiki with knowledge graph, tasks and kanban, calendar with free-time finder, reminders, habits, goals, journal, focus timer, time tracking, finance, contacts, bookmarks, team chat, inbox, an offline AI engine with optional LLM providers, a copilot agent with voice, a points/shop game layer, skill wallet and prompt manager.
